title: Unique normalized comparison of restricted coefficient towers
statement: For every prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, and scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$, there exists a unique natural isomorphism from sequence direct image [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core] followed by coefficientSequenceRestriction on Y [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site] to coefficientSequenceRestriction on X followed by termwise sfCompletedModuleDirectImage [def-strict-coefficient-completed-image-data]. Its component at every input module, coefficient index and pro-etale test object is the identity on underlying sections, as a heterogeneous equality of the actual section elements.

source.place: Primitive tensor reassociation, evaluation and adjunction unit/counit comparisons; agent-formulated component of lem-sf-integral-basic-realization.

proof.text: At each coefficient level, compose the restriction/evaluation equality, the direct-image/evaluation isomorphism, the scalar-restriction comparison for completed direct image, and the inverse restriction/evaluation equality. The coefficient presentations for the finite direct images are definitionally equal.

Each factor is the identity on underlying sections. Use the stated horizontal-map normalization of coefficientSequenceRestriction and the fact that pro-etale base change maps an identity to an identity. The square of the finite comparisons with each horizontal map therefore commutes. Their naturality in the input module follows from the naturality of each factor. Assemble a natural isomorphism of towers.

If another isomorphism has the same section normalization, its hom agrees on every input module, coefficient level, test object and section. Extensionality of natural transformations and sheaf-module maps gives equality of the two isomorphisms. The construction includes zero modules, identity arrows and empty schemes without additional hypotheses.

theorem integralOrdinaryTowerComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃! e : pullbackTensorSequenceDirect l E f ⋙ coefficientSequenceRestriction l E Y ≅
      coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X ⋙
        (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ _ _).obj (sfCompletedModuleDirectImage l E f),
      ∀ (M : coefficientSequenceModules l E X) (n : ℕ) (V : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : (((pullbackTensorSequenceDirect l E f ⋙ coefficientSequenceRestriction l E Y).obj
          M).obj (op n)).val.obj V),
        HEq (((e.hom.app M).app (op n)).val.app V x) x
